csv_project_name: CMGC for Portland Community College Hillsboro Center
csv_agency: Portland Community College, Bond Program Office
csv_scope_of_work: Portland Community College seeks CM/GC services for the new Hillsboro Center building. The proposed project will design and build a new approximately 30,000 square foot facility and associated site development. The new structure will include classrooms, a computer lab, clinical labs, chemistry lab, biology lab, meeting rooms, staff office space, and support spaces. A preliminary building program was developed by Process Architecture in collaboration with the College and HSD in 2022. Anticipated services as part of the project include construction management, integrated preconstruction services with the design team, cost estimating, logistics, scheduling, procurement, subcontractor management, coordination with external parties, and more. While on a separate lot, the College building will be on a shared site with VGMHC
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Design Build/Developer, Construction/Project Management, Cost Estimating
